Mark your calendars for the upcoming Jackson Heights Orchestra concert, 7:30pm, Wednesday, December 9 2026 at Blessed Sacrament Church (34-43 93rd St, Jackson Heights, NY). Parking will be available.
JHO Artistic Director Alex Wen has created a wonderful program featuring the local NYC violin soloist Nicholas Pappone and including the following repertoire:
1. Mozart: The Magic Flute — Overture
2. Beach: Bal Masqué
3. Chausson: Poème
4. Beethoven: Symphony No. 1
We are very thankful to the Jackson Heights Beautification Group for making this wonderful partnership possible by working with the office of Assemblywoman Catalina Cruz NY to help fund this important opportunity for our community.
